Class PolymerNetworkDefinition

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.PolymerNetworkDefinition
public final class PolymerNetworkDefinition extends Object
A recipe for polymer chains connected by branches or crosslinks.

A crosslink is a bond joining different chains or different parts of a chain. For example, several long chains joined by occasional crosslinks form a network.

The recipe can expose settings such as chain length and the chance of adding each branch or crosslink. Call preview(NetworkPreviewRequest) to build one model with chosen settings and a seed. The same recipe, settings, and seed produce the same model.

Each model has its own atom counts and formula. The recipe does not have one formula or mass that applies to every setting. Coordinates and chemical details remain the author's responsibility.
